source_audits.source_name: Belfast City Council Planning Committee agendas, minutes and public report packs
source_audits.source_type: official local authority planning committee minutes/agendas/PDFs
source_audits.coverage_note: Searched targeted 2015-2026 committee pages and public report packs for Belfast major development, housing, hotel, student accommodation, office, civic/cultural, healthcare/education, transport-building and heritage-conversion items.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Belfast City Council public committee records; website terms/copyright may apply. This audit stores factual metadata, short paraphrases and source links only.
source_audits.reliability: High for committee meeting date, application reference, proposal description and committee action recorded in the minutes.
source_audits.date_caveats: Committee approval/refusal dates are not necessarily decision-notice issue dates, section 76 completion dates, construction starts or real-world completion dates.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: Committee records usually provide addresses but not coordinates or site polygons; candidate coordinates are manually approximated from the named address or site context.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use for planning/committee milestones with clear limitations; corroborate final decision notices on the NI Planning Portal where a later pipeline needs legal decision-date precision.

source_audits.source_name: Belfast City Council Planning decisions issued May 2025 PDF
source_audits.coverage_note: Reviewed May 2025 decisions-issued list for non-duplicate architecture/development permissions and consents.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Belfast City Council public PDF; website terms/copyright may apply. This audit stores factual row metadata and links only.
source_audits.reliability: High for application reference, location, proposal description and decision status as listed in the official monthly decisions PDF.
source_audits.date_caveats: The PDF is a monthly list and was generated on 2025-06-10; this pass uses month precision where no row-level decision day was extracted.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: The decisions PDF gives addresses but not coordinates; candidate points are address approximations.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use for month-precision decision milestones unless later NI Planning Portal extraction adds exact decision-issued dates.

source_audits.source_name: Belfast City Council live major applications not previously considered by Committee at 06.05.25
source_audits.source_type: official local authority current/live major applications PDF
source_audits.coverage_note: Reviewed current major applications list as of 2025-05-06 for non-duplicate Belfast architecture/development records.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Belfast City Council public PDF; website terms/copyright may apply. This audit stores factual row metadata and links only.
source_audits.reliability: High for status at report generation date, application reference, location, proposal, valid date and target date.
source_audits.date_caveats: These are application-stage/current records, not approvals. Candidate dates use the official Date Valid field; status is only documented as of the PDF timestamp.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: Coordinates are approximate; some schemes cover multi-site park, reservoir or linear public-realm extents.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Ingest as current/application milestones only, visually distinct from approved or completed changes.

source_audits.source_name: Northern Ireland Planning Portal / Planning Register
source_audits.publisher: Department for Infrastructure and Northern Ireland planning authorities
source_audits.coverage_note: Used as the official lookup target for application references; this pass did not bulk scrape dynamic portal pages.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Portal public-access terms and copyright limitations apply. Use factual identifiers and link users to the portal rather than reproducing application documents.
source_audits.reliability: High for application-register details when a reference is looked up directly; URLs and dynamic pages may not be stable for static citation.
source_audits.date_caveats: Portal dates can include received, valid, decided, advertised and appeal dates; do not treat any portal date as construction or occupation date.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: Portal map/location data should be reviewed per application before replacing the approximate points in this candidate pack.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use as follow-up validation for final decision-date precision, document URLs and site geometry; keep BCC minute/PDF citations as stable committee evidence.

source_audits.source_name: Department for Infrastructure strategic planning, called-in and advertised applications
source_audits.coverage_note: Checked DfI called-in/advertised records for Belfast items; Belfast Transport Hub and related condition/adverts were treated as duplicates or lower-level condition milestones for this pass.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Crown copyright and Department for Infrastructure website terms may apply. This audit stores factual metadata and links only.
source_audits.reliability: High for DfI publication date, advert date, called-in status and strategic-planning record descriptions.
source_audits.date_caveats: DfI advert or called-in dates are application-process milestones, not local committee decisions or construction dates.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: DfI adverts often provide broad site descriptions rather than coordinates; use application register geometry if selected later.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use for called-in/regional application milestones after duplicate checks against existing Belfast Transport Hub, Casement Park and other already-ingested major schemes.
